level 1 (weight 5: executes, engine); cue: a falsifier fires on a measurement taken on a stand-in backend that does not exercise the quantity being estimated
level 1 (weight 5: executes, engine); cue: a run record names its backend through an attribute lookup with a default, so a missing attribute silently produces a false claim
level 1 (weight 5: executes, engine); cue: a run tool writes into a run directory whose id was picked by hand from a listing, in a tree where several seats run sweeps
level 1 (weight 5: executes, engine); cue: prose or comments state a count or a status recalled from memory, and go stale or wrong as runs land
level 1 (weight 5: executes, engine); cue: a parked falsifier names a backend or a present-tense fact about the machine rather than an artefact the repository can show
